note: Ground punch to the BODY from side control. The other hand to the head punch: in side control the right hand is already at his far hip, under the ribs, which is why that is where the body shots come from. It lifts a hand's width clear, turns over and digs back in under the elbow. No wind-up at all - lying across a man there is nowhere to take it.

keys.note: cocked: 15 cm off him, no more
in under the elbow and into the ribs, which are straight down from him
